title: PMC OA ingestion tool (OA Web Service/BioC API) + license/provenance capture
context: The ingestion tool retrieves Ewing articles from the PMC OA Subset and emits canonical records valid against schema-002, capturing machine-readable license and provenance per article. Binding cancer guardrails apply: open-access (PMC OA Subset) / aggregate / de-identified data only; no identifiable patient data; no medical advice; provenance on every assertion. Non-OA hits are reduced to bibliographic metadata only; no NCBI API key is ever committed.
objective: Build the PMC OA ingestion tool that emits schema-002-valid records with captured license and provenance.
acceptanceCriteria: Retrieves articles only from the PMC OA Subset (OA Web Service / BioC API / OA packages); non-OA hits reduced to bibliographic metadata only.
Captures and records the machine-readable license, license URL, and snapshot per article.
Emits canonical records valid against schema-002; ships golden fixtures (synthetic/public) exercised in CI; no NCBI API key committed (env var only).
Code MIT-licensed; pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm lint green; DCO signed-off.
resources: PubMed Central Open Access Subset documentation (OA Web Service; BioC API)
